observations.friction: The OMP LSP rule interrupted a Prettier check for unrelated plan-rule files even though its policy excludes unrelated repository toolchain work.
observations.workaround: Use the background formatter result and continue without applying the unrelated LSP guidance.

pc-127bb3af1002afa4.summary: Narrow the OMP LSP rule activation so unrelated formatter commands do not interrupt.

observations.friction: The helper requires the target path to exist before git add, so deleted allow-listed files fail with path does not exist.
observations.workaround: Stage the exact deleted allow-listed path with git add -- path, matching the helper's add invocation.

pc-1bbd03aa0a592ee3.summary: Deleted manifest-allowed paths cannot be staged through the helper.

observations.friction: Each valid case duplicates the rendered report in both prompt and expected_output; a format change can update one copy while leaving the other stale.
observations.workaround: Parse each input fence and rewrite both report copies from the same changed array, then assert they match.

pc-4a26350015d31957.summary: Keep embedded prompt goldens and expected outputs synchronized.

observations.friction: During installed-root acceptance checks, rule://plan, rule://plan-repo-storage, and rule://plan-impl-spec resolved but exposed bytes older than their current repository source counterparts, leaving runtime policy consumers at risk of applying stale plan rules.
observations.workaround: Validated the updated improve plan template directly through the installed validator and left out-of-scope installed state unchanged.

pc-5d2832458e2311c6.summary: Prevent installed rule locators from serving policy bytes older than their repository sources.

observations.friction: Exact projection of two finalized specification checks made plan publication fail with DIRECT_CHECK_INVALID because they used a period and capitalized Expect instead of the required semicolon-expect delimiter.
observations.workaround: The existing specification author mechanically corrected only the two delimiters in a new bound revision; ticketing refreshed the exact projection and republished successfully.

pc-6d31171d9c5f04c1.summary: Final specification Check strings can omit the lean-plan parser's required semicolon-expect delimiter.

observations.friction: A final confirmation interaction exposed confirmation choices without the proposal body they were meant to bind, forcing a repeated proposal and risking approval of unseen content.
observations.workaround: Repeat the complete final proposal immediately with the confirmation control and include a compact bound preview.

pc-7360992214c3cd7d.summary: Bind the complete final proposal body to the confirmation interaction.

observations.friction: Two proof or control runs left an authoritative native observation vulnerable when an enclosing finite Eval expired while a child wait was still pending; the latest recurrence terminally blocked the required lifecycle proof even though the child later settled.
observations.workaround: Use direct hub collection or persist the complete original outside ephemeral Eval state before any further wait; never reconstruct an original after reset.

pc-8ba3fb81c3a65110.summary: Bounded Eval waits can reset ephemeral invocation state before the original native observation is retained.

observations.friction: At the same report-production seam, one earlier implementation return lacked canonical Handoff grammar and the later T1 PID-correction return wrapped exact Behavior/Check projections in outer Markdown code ticks while escaping embedded ticks. Both otherwise-complete returns were blocked from admission.
observations.workaround: Produce the report from the canonical Handoff template, splice exact Behavior/Check lines directly from the current plan bytes, and verify byte equality while preserving retained Observed lines. Carry durable prevention guidance to the existing assembled-target learning stage.

pc-8f42da4f483dde9a.summary: Exact Handoff reports are manually composed instead of mechanically projecting the canonical envelope and source acceptance lines.

observations.friction: Two independent fresh sizing route completions selected the correct owner, topology, and assurance but omitted Approval because proposal-only route presentation was not explicitly distinguished from dispatch.
observations.workaround: Add one explicit connection in the existing dev-ask routing owner, then repeat the unchanged coupled and recovery completions.

pc-a2525abd541246f2.summary: Classify proposal-only sizing routes as dispatchable presentation so the five-field approval gate is retained.

observations.friction: When existing baseline cases were revised, keep-check rejected eight of them even though they were already classified in ADDED_IDS, because baseline keep exclusion consults REWRITE_IDS separately. Maintainers must know when one case ID belongs in both sets.
observations.workaround: Run the pinned keep-check after every registry edit and duplicate each changed baseline-present ID into REWRITE_IDS.

pc-a556fa1f9529ba9a.summary: Make changed-case classification follow the pinned baseline without overlapping manual ID sets.

observations.friction: Repeated assurance-tail refinements still leave a risk of narrowly scoped proof or duplicated reviewer opinions, which can make repair and rerun work lower-value than intended.
observations.workaround: Manually inspect repository verification guidance, freeze criterion-specific proof recipes, and consolidate direct-evidence findings under the existing bounded repair and one-review contracts.

pc-ae711c27c4d758b7.summary: Make repository-specific proof mechanics and bounded evidence partitioning explicit before assurance runs.

observations.friction: The approved command used .config/... as Bun's test filter; Bun 1.3.14 searched visible test files and ran no target, so every focused check required an execution-recovery correction before it could start.

pc-bb25646ca64861fc.summary: Prefix hidden repository test paths with ./ so Bun treats them as paths.
pc-bb25646ca64861fc.surface: T1 lifecycle plan Bun test commands

observations.friction: A delivered child report arriving after the stock finite awaited-send window was previously classified as missing even though stock OMP retained the original structured message for native wait collection.
observations.workaround: Continue observation through a child-restricted native wait while preserving the prebound provenance predicate and any same-child wrong-token traffic as ordinary.

pc-c08404f743229ebd.summary: Treat finite awaited-send expiry as a pending report and continue only through provenance-valid native surfaces.

observations.friction: Six new execution-recovery projection requirements were reported missing even though their source clauses were present, blocking AC-REC-4 until diagnosis showed that normalize() retains commas while the alternatives omitted them.
observations.workaround: Copy each source snippet's normalized punctuation exactly into REQUIRED_PROJECTIONS alternatives.

pc-cb1b8cb02f18d49b.summary: Required-projection matching preserves punctuation while projection authors can assume punctuation-insensitive normalization.

observations.friction: plan.md forbids ## Execution gate on new or revised executable plans, but executor_plan.py --consumer planner reports status=valid when that section is present
observations.workaround: after planner validation, inspect headings for ## Execution gate and reject or remove it before publication

pc-e1c8b1660bfd1b81.summary: planner validator accepts obsolete Execution gate
